lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  induction Basis.mem_span ofCrAnListFBasis b using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem b hb =>
    rcases hb with ⟨ys, rfl⟩
    rw [ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
    induction Basis.mem_span ofCrAnListFBasis a using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem a ha =>
      rcases ha with ⟨xs, rfl⟩
      rw [ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
      let l1 := (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
        ((xs ++ ys).insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel)) ++
        (List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) xs)
      let l2 := (List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) ys) ++
        (List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)
        ((xs ++ ys).insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel))
      have hs (l : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) (h : ∀ c ∈ l,
          crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) :
          ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (xs ++ l ++ ys))) =
          ι (ofCrAnListF l1) * ι (ofCrAnListF l) * ι (ofCrAnListF l2) := by
        rw [crAnTimeOrderList, insertionSort_of_eq_list _ φ xs l ys h]
        simp only [ofCrAnListF_append, map_mul, l1, l2, mul_assoc]
      calc
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (xs ++ φ :: ψ :: ys) •
            (ι (ofCrAnListF l1) * ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF *
              ι (ofCrAnListF l2)) := by
          conv_lhs =>
            rw [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
              superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF]
            simp only [ofList_singleton, mul_sub, sub_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm,
              Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, ← ofCrAnListF_append, map_sub, map_smul,
              timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
          simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append] at hs ⊢
          rw [← crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ]
          have h12 := hs [φ, ψ] (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])
          have h21 := hs [ψ, φ] (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])
          simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append] at h12 h21
          rw [h12, h21]
          simp only [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, ofCrAnListF_cons,
            ofCrAnListF_nil, mul_one, map_mul, map_sub, map_smul, smul_sub, mul_sub,
            sub_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc]
          module
        _ = ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF xs * ofCrAnListF ys)) := by
          rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp
            (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ)]
          have hr : crAnTimeOrderList (xs ++ ys) = l1 ++ l2 := by
            simpa only [crAnTimeOrderList, l1, l2, List.append_assoc] using
              insertionSort_of_takeWhile_filter 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ xs ys
          rw [mul_assoc, ← map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append, ← hr]
          by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) ≠ (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
          · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, zero_mul, smul_zero, map_mul]
          · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ
              (not_ne_iff.mp hq).symm, ← crAnTimeOrderSign,
              ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
            simp only [map_mul, map_smul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
    | zero => simp only [zero_mul, map_zero, mul_zero]
    | add x y hx hy hpx hpy =>
      simp only [add_mul, map_add, mul_add, hpx, hpy]
    | smul c x hx hpx =>
      simp only [Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, map_smul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, hpx]
  | zero => simp only [mul_zero, map_zero]
  | add x y hx hy hpx hpy => simp only [mul_add, map_add, hpx, hpy]
  | smul c x hx hpx => simp only [Algebra.mul_smul_comm, map_smul, hpx]
